note: What a ConceptNet ability DOES in play. Each key is an ability label exactly as config/abilities.json gives it (built offline from ConceptNet 5.7), so every effect traces to a real assertion about the class; a class gets an effect only if ConceptNet gives it that ability (Kent, 2026-11-16: 'ConceptNet only' -- the shark has Rough Hide, and no bite, because ConceptNet says so). Kinds: strike -- the body's F action, a blow through apply_tool_hit, numbers in config/weapons.json under `id`; grab -- the F action, holds what it catches still for `hold_seconds`; armor -- passive, the body takes a blow for her, then needs `ready_seconds` to take another; scorch -- a placed light that burns what stands in it (UtilityObject). A body with more than one gets the first strike, else the first grab, as its F action. CreatureAbility reads this file; run_creature_ability_probe holds every label to abilities.json.
